text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring) ended with her 
conceding the win. While praising the 
other Umamusume who ran, she resolves to 
win next time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next target race is the "Takarazuka 
Kinen." Heading out for self-training the 
following morning, she catches sight of 
Mejiro McQueen putting in the laps.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikane Tannhauser is deeply inspired by 
seeing her run so stoically in order to 
achieve further growth at the Takarazuka 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The GⅠ medium-distance Takarazuka Kinen is 
in two months. To seize victory, I need to 
give training everything I've got!
